english.title: Fail to ensure CCTV system in relation to slaughterhouse was operational when animals present
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the business operator of a slaughterhouse, namely **(..SPECIFY SLAUGHTERHOUSE..), failed to ensure that a CCTV system, installed to provide a complete and clear image of killing and related operations in all areas of the slaughterhouse where live animals were present, was operational and kept in good working order at all times when live animals were present at the slaughterhouse
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 3(3), 9(1)(a) and 12 of the Mandatory Use of Closed Circuit Television in Slaughterhouses (England) Regulations 2018.
